races.display_title: Shelley Coles - Setting the Pace at 60 Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The switch to fences may see an improved effort from lightly-raced MINELLA JURY , who showed plenty of promise in the early part of last season and returns with his yard bang in form. A compelling case can be made for each of the others, with Juggernaut perhaps the most likely danger following a comfortable success over C&D last time. MINELLA JURY (IRE) JUGGERNAUT (FR) INSIDE MAN (FR)

races.verdict: CITY CAPTAIN took his form to another level when narrowly failing to land a gamble here last week so looks the one to beat off the same mark. Francisco's Piece is next best after his eye-catching run in the Ayr Bronze Cup, while Topwarrior offered a bit more in this headgear at Doncaster last time and is back on a winning mark. CITY CAPTAIN FRANCISCO'S PIECE TOPWARRIOR

races.verdict: None of these can be ruled out but the vote goes to DARKEST RED who arrives on the back of a very good Epsom second and can go well again nudged up 2 lb. DARKEST RED MISS GUINEVERE (IRE) LOVE YOU BACK (IRE)

races.verdict: BALOO'S BLUES has had a solid campaign and is taken to go one better than over C&D a fortnight ago. Little She went close to a breakthrough success at Lingfield 4 weeks ago and is second choice ahead of Star Start , who was well held last time but has a good overall record under today's rider Charli Parker. races.verdict: BUNGLE BAY is one of few who obviously arrives in decent form and might be good for a sixth C&D success. Tilsworth Max has saved his best all-weather form to date for Lingfield's polytrack but he will be a threat if close to the form he showed when runner-up there 18 days ago. Sanditon also has a bit of class for this grade if back on his game. BUNGLE BAY (IRE) TILSWORTH MAX SANDITON (IRE)

races.verdict: A mightily difficult puzzle with several potentially ahead of their marks. DUCE BIGALOW gets the nod in his bid to make it 2-2 for his present yard. Bruise Hill and Ardgillan are both feared, especially as the pace has the potential to be strong. Ancient Myth completes the shortlist. DUCE BIGALOW (IRE) BRUISE HILL (IRE) ARDGILLAN (IRE)

races.display_title: Castlecoote Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SMALLCRAFTWARNING did well to finish in the frame having come from further back than the other principals at Listowel last week and now racing back from his 'proper mark' John Ryan's 9-y-o gets the verdict to regain the winning thread. Watching The Clock heads up the dangers having gone close at Wexford back in the spring, with West Is Awake and Roc My Haarth another couple worth considering, too. SMALLCRAFTWARNING (IRE) WATCHING THE CLOCK (IRE) WEST IS AWAKE (IRE)

races.verdict: A half-sister to a useful hurdler, DR BONES makes plenty of appeal and she could be up to becoming another winning bumper debutant for her powerful stable. She gets the vote ahead of fellow newcomer Finest Band , while Touch The Clouds is worth another chance to build on his debut promise. DR BONES (IRE) TOUCH THE CLOUDS (IRE) FINEST BAND (FR)
